sentences.en: "Take care," the Count said.

sentences.en: "It is bad to cut your face in this house."

sentences.en: Jonathan went to the room where he had eaten, and food was on the table.

sentences.en: There was no other man in the castle, and the Count did all the work.

sentences.en: Jonathan thought of the mirror and the driver and the wolves.
sentences.tgt: Jonathan:o songeait:v au:o miroir:n ,:o au:o cocher:n et:o aux:o loups:n .:o

sentences.en: He wrote in his book, and he wrote of the mirror.

sentences.en: That night the Count came to the room and sat by the fire.

sentences.en: "Tell me about the house in England," he said.

sentences.en: Jonathan told him all that he knew, and the Count asked many things.

sentences.en: The wolves cried, and the Count listened to them.

sentences.en: In the next days Jonathan found a room full of books, and the books were from England.

sentences.en: "I read every day," the Count said, "but I do not speak as you do."

sentences.en: Jonathan wrote it in his book, but he did not know what the Count meant.

sentences.en: When the day came, the Count stopped, and he went out of the room.

sentences.en: Jonathan did not see the Count in the day, and he went out of his room to look at the castle.

sentences.en: He went down the stairs to the big door of the castle, and that door was locked too.

sentences.en: Jonathan knew that he was a prisoner there.

sentences.en: He went back to his room and looked out of the window.

sentences.en: The window was high above the ground, and Jonathan could not go out of it.

sentences.en: At night the Count came to the fire, and Jonathan spoke to him.

sentences.en: "All the doors are locked, and I cannot go out," Jonathan said.

sentences.en: "This is an old castle, and it is bad at night," the Count said.

sentences.en: The Count took the letters and went out of the room.

sentences.en: Jonathan heard the key in the door.

sentences.en: Every night the Count came to Jonathan by the fire, and every morning the Count was gone.

sentences.en: One night Jonathan looked out of his window.

sentences.en: He looked and looked, but the Count went down to the ground and into the dark.

sentences.en: Jonathan thought of the tall driver, and he knew that the driver was the Count.

sentences.en: He was afraid, and he wanted to go home.

sentences.en: He knew that he must go out of the castle.

sentences.en: Jonathan went to the door, and it opened.

sentences.en: The moon was in the window, and there were old chairs and a table in the room.

sentences.en: The wolves cried, but they were not near.
